research_question: Can a pure strong-level failed-auction setup replace the weak S102 weekly short and the sparse FVG dependency while trading both long and short in the direction of the global regime?
selection_disclosure: S108 was designed after S103-S107 results were inspected. Every historical period and symbol is therefore diagnostic, not independent out-of-sample evidence.

data.source: checksum-verified public Binance USD-M daily, 5m kline, funding and 5m metrics archives

direction.global: Frozen S101 asymmetric daily UP/DOWN/SIDEWAYS classifier. Longs only in UP, shorts only in DOWN, no new entries in SIDEWAYS.
direction.local: Last completed 4h close must be on the same side of EMA50 as the trade.

strong_level.lookback: Previous 96 closed 15m candles, excluding the current candle.
strong_level.strength: At least two prior highs/lows within 0.25 ATR of the liquidity extreme.

setup.long_sweep: In UP/4h-up, price trades below the strong prior low by 0.02 ATR and closes back above it while candle taker-buy share <=0.48 and archived taker buy/sell ratio <1.
setup.short_sweep: In DOWN/4h-down, price trades above the strong prior high by 0.02 ATR and closes back below it while candle taker-buy share >=0.52 and archived taker buy/sell ratio >1.
setup.attention: Sweep requires 60-minute OI expansion >=0.05%, relative volume >=1.10 and metrics age <=15 minutes.
setup.funding: Prior seven-day mean funding must be <=0.00005 for longs and >=-0.00005 for shorts, rejecting the most one-sided carry against the reversal.
setup.confirmation: Within the next three closed 15m candles, close must break the sweep candle high for a long or low for a short by 0.03 ATR, have the matching candle direction, and show matching candle and archive taker flow. Fill is at the next 5m open.

risk_and_exit.account: One global position across all six symbols; highest evidence score wins simultaneous entries.
risk_and_exit.risk: Base risk is 0.2% equity capped at $0.50, multiplied by a frozen 0.50 signal scale. Leverage <=5, notional <=75% NAV, margin <=15% NAV.
risk_and_exit.stop: Beyond the actual sweep extreme plus 0.20 ATR; widen only to the frozen 1.25 ATR minimum, reject if wider than 3.50 ATR. Initial stop is never widened or moved.
risk_and_exit.target: Front-run 90% of the distance to opposite 96-bar liquidity. Require at least 1.80R at decision and fill; cap take-profit at 3.00R.

predeclared_historical_gate.combined_sample: Stress: at least 18 fills, positive PnL, PF >1.15, DD <=5%; severe PnL positive.
predeclared_historical_gate.direction: Stress: at least five executed longs and five executed shorts; both directions have non-negative PnL.
predeclared_historical_gate.breadth: Stress: at least three represented symbols; at least four of six leave-one-symbol-out PnLs positive.
predeclared_historical_gate.cluster_portability: Primary and portability three-symbol diagnostic portfolios must each have at least six stress fills and non-negative stress and severe PnL.
predeclared_historical_gate.time: At least three of four predeclared stress slices have positive PnL and no stress slice is below -$1.00.
predeclared_historical_gate.uncertainty: Deterministic circular 28-day block bootstrap p10 terminal PnL must be positive.
predeclared_historical_gate.promotion: Passing every check can start paper-forward observation only; failure rejects S108. Live remains disabled.

claim_policy: No historical result guarantees profit. No parameter may change after this protocol is hashed and before the frozen replay completes.
